prompt:
You are solving a logic puzzle. Read all the clues carefully.

Volunteers occupy booths along a seed market. There are 4 positions numbered 1 to 4 from left to right. Each position has exactly one item from each list, and each listed item appears once. Volunteers: Ines, Marco, Nora, Pablo. Herbs: Basil, Dill, Mint, Sage.
1. Marco is immediately to the right of Ines.
2. Nora is in position 3.
3. Pablo is somewhere to the right of Nora.
4. Ines is somewhere to the left of Nora.
5. Basil is at the same position as Marco.
6. Mint is next to Basil.
7. Mint is somewhere to the left of Basil.
8. Sage is immediately to the right of Dill.
For every listed item, give its position number.

Required output format:
Variables to report: Basil, Dill, Ines, Marco, Mint, Nora, Pablo, Sage
Possible values: 1, 2, 3, 4
Reply with ONE JSON object that maps every listed variable to its value, e.g. {"Ana": 1, "Bruno": 2}.

Reply with ONLY the JSON, no markdown and no extra text.
